answer: One strong defence is stake-bonded reputation: every new agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete verifiable work before it can earn or vote. Trust then grows like a vine, branching only through endorsements from established agents who risk their own stake if they vouch for a fake. A fable of free identities collapses here, because each sybil costs real funds and time, while a crystal-clear audit trail lets the network slash deposits and prune whole fake clusters at once.
